events.text:
workspace_identity:
  name: "Maestro v5-b cold-start/runtime reconstruction workspace"
  type: v5_wip
  date_window: "2026-04-13 to 2026-05-20"
  approximate_session_count: 10
  custom_gpt_or_project: "ChatGPT project/gizmo: maestro-v5b; loaded v5-b cold-start pack plus pinned governance, schema, runtime, and template files"

unique_contribution:
  description: >
    This workspace uniquely holds the v5-b cold-start operational pack as a
    compact runtime system: dual-scaffold initialization, work-item execution,
    council ownership, evidence contract, gate enforcement, and constrained
    two-file runtime view. Its strongest contribution is not final Suno output
    but the attempt to make Maestro execution audit-safe through pinned schemas,
    mandatory logs, addressable Technical UST, and stop-the-line phase gates.
    It also preserves the Creative MAP parity patch and the explicit distinction
    between Creative UST as Suno-facing and Technical UST as internal worksheet.
  artifacts:

- "WORK_ITEM_SCHEMA.md: defines WI.P{phase}.{axis}.{k_range}.R{round} card fields, required evidence, definition of done, and outputs."
    - "COUNCIL_MATRIX.md: pins SME owners, adjacent reviewers, tie-break authorities, V&V Marshal scope, and physics override."
    - "EXECUTABLE_CHAIN.md: defines Phase 0 through Phase 5 as monolithic RUN with atomic work items and hard gates."

- "EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.md: defines valid Technical UST fills, source bindings, downstream predictions, challenge cycles, and mandatory logs."
    - "TECHNICAL_UST_CANON.md: authoritative addressable Technical UST hierarchy across THY/VOC/STY/TIM/PERF/POST/MAP/LYR plus attached validation layers."
    - "TECHNICAL_UST_GOVERNANCE_ADDENDUM.md: first-class SEG, G-Card, SE20, cross-axis bindings, and phase integration guarantee."

- "CREATIVE_UST_TEMPLATE.txt: Suno-facing Creative UST scaffold with formatting rules, Road Map block, post-production block, and lyrics block discipline."
    - "runtime/context.md and runtime/solution.md: constrained two-file runtime summary and playbook for limited-context operation."

current_open_state:
  last_active_work_item: "Cross-workspace Day 2 alignment prep; current workspace self-report requested under v3-style validation/documentation constraints."
  active_sidechains:

- sidechain_id: "SC.V5B.COLDSTART.RUNTIME_VIEW"
      source_origin: "v5-b cold-start pack and pinned governance files"
      target_address_or_phase: "Phase 0 through Phase 5 runtime execution model"
      authority_boundary: "BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE; runtime/context.md is explicitly derived from canonical docs and is not a replacement for them"
      gate_effect: "Enforces dual scaffold, Phase 2 work-item execution, Phase 3 SEG/G-Card/SE20/CAP/LOCK gates, and stop-the-line behavior"
      completion_status: "partial"

- sidechain_id: "SC.V5B.CREATIVE_MAP_PARITY"
      source_origin: "Migration Log plus Creative UST template"
      target_address_or_phase: "Creative UST Road Map block and Technical MAP axis parity"
      authority_boundary: "PROJECT_MAESTRO where MAP parity is canon; WORKSPACE_DEV where applied through template mechanics"
      gate_effect: "Prevents structural wandering by keeping MAP addressability available in both Creative and Technical planes"
      completion_status: "active"

- sidechain_id: "SC.V5B.EVIDENCE_AND_LOGGING"
      source_origin: "Evidence Contract, Work Item Schema, Log Templates, Council Protocol"
      target_address_or_phase: "Phase 2 fills, Phase 3 gates, Phase 5 audit delivery"
      authority_boundary: "PROJECT_MAESTRO for evidence law; WORKSPACE_DEV for concrete log instantiation"
      gate_effect: "Blocks unbound claims, unchallenged fills, missing dissent, and unsupported gate pass records"
      completion_status: "partial"
  active_slipstreams:

- slipstream_id: "SS.V5B.TWO_FILE_CONSTRAINED_RUNTIME"
      name: "Constrained Runtime View"
      lifecycle_state: "active"
      origin_delta: "Condenses full cold-start pack into runtime/context.md plus runtime/solution.md"
      reason_for_existence: "Allows limited-context operation without treating the condensed files as canonical replacements"

- slipstream_id: "SS.V5B.NULL_HUNTING_WORK_ITEMS"
      name: "Phase 2 NULL Hunting"
      lifecycle_state: "active"
      origin_delta: "Moves from monolithic prompt execution to addressable work-item fills by axis and key range"
      reason_for_existence: "Prevents teleological compression by making each Technical UST fill evidentiary, reviewable, and logged"

- slipstream_id: "SS.V5B.CAP_AND_LOCK_GOVERNANCE"
      name: "CAP/LOCK Enforcement"
      lifecycle_state: "active"
      origin_delta: "Separates editable meta/sFX/stage directions from locked quoted lyric text and enforces character-budget gates"
      reason_for_existence: "Keeps Suno-facing outputs safe from accidental lyric rewrite and prompt-budget drift"
  open_q_a_without_f:

- q: "Whether v5-b should be considered operational canon or only a cold-start WIP/runtime proposal."
      a: "This workspace presently frames v5-b as a cold-start monolithic RUN system with pinned laws, phases, gates, and runtime views."
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: "2026-05-20 current workspace"

- q: "Whether the v3 protocol stack is actually loaded in this workspace or only referenced by the incoming cross-workspace query."
      a: "The current visible workspace contains v5-b governance and runtime files, but the v3 protocol stack itself is not directly present as a loaded artifact."
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: "2026-05-20 current workspace"

- q: "Whether the Triad-validator slice from the other Claude session should supersede v5-b gate definitions or merely validate them."
      a: "This workspace can only treat the Triad-validator as externally reported context; no local validator artifact is visible here."
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: "2026-05-20 current workspace"
  unresolved_contradictions:

- "The user-supplied wider context says v5 and v5-b never went operational, while this workspace's cold-start pack is written as an executable Maestro v5-b monolithic RUN."
    - "The prompt requires operation under MAESTRO v3 protocol, but the visible local artifacts are v5-b cold-start governance rather than the v3 protocol stack."

- "The system identity states Maestro v5-b, while the cross-workspace query asks for Day 2 alignment against v5-c canonical root and other external workspaces not locally loaded."

cross_workspace_conflicts_or_supersessions:
  - this_workspace_holds: "Dual-scaffold Phase 0 is mandatory before SME work."
    likely_conflicts_with: "Older single-document chains and any workflow that starts with artifact generation or direct Suno prompt compilation."
    proposed_resolution: "Supersede older single-document chains for v5-b-derived work; preserve them as lineage evidence only."

- this_workspace_holds: "Technical UST is internal-only; Creative UST is Suno-facing."
    likely_conflicts_with: "Any workspace that emits Technical UST or technical worksheet content as a Suno-facing prompt."
    proposed_resolution: "Treat this as canon unless operator adjudicates otherwise; Technical UST may feed compilation but should not be emitted as final prompt."

- this_workspace_holds: "No triad outputs before Phase 3 gates pass."
    likely_conflicts_with: "POC/WIP workspaces that generate final artifacts before SEG/G-Card/SE20/CAP/LOCK validation."
    proposed_resolution: "Classify such outputs as draft demonstrations, not canon deliverables."
  - this_workspace_holds: "Every meaningful Technical UST fill requires source binding, downstream prediction, and challenge cycle."
    likely_conflicts_with: "Prior heuristic or stylebook work that relies on expert prose without address-level evidence."
    proposed_resolution: "Use prior heuristic work as source material only after conversion into bound work items."

- this_workspace_holds: "V5-b has a complete executable chain through Phase 5."
    likely_conflicts_with: "Forensic workspace correction that v5/v5-b never became operational."
    proposed_resolution: "Needs operator adjudication; safest bridge label is 'operationally specified but not historically proven operational.'"

day_2_readiness_markers:
  patent_novelty_claims_articulated_here:
    - "Addressable dual-scaffold music-generation orchestration: Creative UST remains Suno-facing while Technical UST functions as an internal reversible worksheet with asymmetric schema depth and parity at AXIS+KEY level."
    - "Evidence-bound work-item execution for generative music prompts: each subkey fill must be a one-sentence operational constraint with source binding, downstream sensitivity, peer challenge, and dissent logging."

- "Stop-the-line gate stack for AI music prompt compilation: SEG feasibility, G-Card scoring, SE20 quality/lineage review, CAP budget, and LOCK compliance jointly block final prompt emission until pass records exist."
    - "Runtime degradation architecture: constrained two-file operation is allowed only as a derived runtime view and not as canonical replacement for pinned governance files."
  worker_contracts_operationalized: partial
  worker_contract_evidence: "Council ownership, reviewers, tie-breaks, V&V Marshal scope, work-item schema, required SME outputs, and challenge protocol exist; missing pieces are executable worker I/O schemas, classifier dispatch contracts, test fixtures, and machine-verifiable run logs."
  classifier_routing_rules_drafted: partial
  classifier_routing_evidence: "Axis-to-owner routing exists through Council Matrix and work-item IDs; formal PENDING_CLASSIFIER routing rules from Chimera-V2 are not locally visible in this workspace."
  vig_sel_post_generation_pipeline_status: not_addressed
  vig_sel_evidence: "The incoming prompt reports v0.1 VIG/SEL and downstream dossiers in another Claude session, but this workspace has no loaded VIG/SEL pipeline artifact."

scope_classification_per_three_planes:
  PROJECT_MAESTRO:
    - "Dual-scaffold Phase 0 requirement: Creative [NULL] plus Technical [NULL]."
    - "Creative UST is Suno-facing; Technical UST is internal worksheet."
    - "Technical UST address grammar and axes: THY, VOC, STY, TIM, PERF, POST, MAP, LYR, plus SEG/G/SE20 governance layers."

- "No Suno/triad output before Phase 3 gates pass."
    - "Stop-the-line on SEG, LOCK, unresolved NULLs, unaddressed contradictions, failed CAP, or insufficient G/SE20 validation."
    - "Lyrics lock scope applies to quoted lyric text; meta tags, stage directions, and sFX markers remain editable."

- "Mandatory logs: run ledger, work item ledger, dissent map, consensus minutes, gate results, cap report, lock report, telemetry."
  WORKSPACE_DEV:
    - "Current self-report under cross-workspace Day 2 alignment prep."
    - "Use of v5-b cold-start pack as this workspace's available local evidence base."

- "Two-file runtime compression strategy for constrained runs."
    - "Approximate session reconstruction from visible project conversation list rather than full workspace archive."
    - "Open classification of this workspace as v5_wip rather than proven operational root."
  BRIDGE_PROJECT_WORKSPACE:

- "Work-item model bridges project doctrine to executable Day 2 validation slices."
    - "Council Matrix bridges musical SME roles to operational worker contracts."
    - "Evidence Contract bridges artistic intent, raw intake, technical constraints, and auditability."
    - "runtime/context.md and runtime/solution.md bridge full canonical pack to constrained execution environments."

- "Creative MAP parity patch bridges Creative UST prompt structure with Technical MAP addressability."
  UNRESOLVED_SCOPE:
    - "Whether v3 protocol requirements supersede, wrap, or merely classify the v5-b cold-start pack."
    - "Whether externally reported v5-c Canonical Root supersedes this v5-b workspace."

- "Whether Triad-validator slice should become a required Phase 3/4 validation dependency."
    - "Whether patent novelty claims should be drafted from v5-b alone or only from cross-workspace synthesis."
    - "Whether hidden-costs RAG-poisoning diagnosis changes the Evidence Contract or sits outside Maestro core canon."

handoff_to_synthesizing_claude:
  most_important_thing_to_carry_forward: >
    This workspace contributes the v5-b execution substrate: dual-scaffold
    initialization, addressable Technical UST, evidence-bound work items,
    contested SME review, mandatory logs, and hard Phase 3 gates. Treat it as
    operationally specified infrastructure, not as proof that v5-b historically
    became the operational root.
  warning_about_misreading_this_workspace: >
    Do not flatten the clean v5-b cold-start pack into project canon without
    preserving the conflict that prior forensic context says v5/v5-b never went
    operational. Also do not mistake runtime/context.md for canonical authority;
    it is a constrained derivative of the pinned docs.
  recommended_next_slice_from_this_workspace_perspective: >
    evidence-contract. This workspace is strongest where it specifies evidence,
    work-item definitions of done, dissent logs, and gate pass records; Day 2
    should convert those into machine-verifiable schemas and validator fixtures
    before expanding classifier routing.
